text: The initiative features automatic attachment of public catastrophe cover to private home insurance policies, a doubled cap aligned with cost inflation, and a levy rate reduction alongside the higher cap. It also includes coverage for certain residential land damage from storms and floods, ensuring broad participation and risk pooling.

metadata.solution_name: Doubling of the Residential Building Cap and Levy Adjustment under EQCover (Toka Tū Ake EQC)
